name: Summon Raging Spirit Necromancer
summary: League-start minion build that trades skeletons for a swarm of raging spirits. The spirits are temporary, aggressive and scale with minion damage, so the same budget caster gear that proves the skeleton build proves this one. No required unique.

pros.text: No required unique; gem levels and minion stats carry the damage.
The spirits seek enemies on their own, so clear does not need precise aiming.
Aggressive minions keep damage uptime high while you move.
Uses the same caster budget as the skeleton build, so gear is easy to reuse.
A strong boss setup once the spirits are stacked.
Offering and corpse setup rewards planning but is not mandatory early.

cons.text: The spirits expire, so damage falls off if you stop casting.
You are fragile when the minion wall breaks or you are caught alone.
Clear speed is slower than a bow build.
Many gems compete for slots and links.
Minion AI can waste the swarm on a single tanky rare.
Leveling is clunky before the first minion notables.

pantheon.note: Gruthkul reduces the physical hits that catch a caster in a bad position.

summary.text: Summon Raging Spirit Necromancer is a league-start minion build that measures 140.2k at red maps and 205.1k at pinnacle. The spirits seek enemies on their own, the caster gear is shared with the skeleton build, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with raging spirits and a minion damage support; they are available early and keep moving while you do. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 337 damage; the second measures 1.2k. A mana flask covers the repeated casts.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 140.2k damage, 29822 effective life and 13442 physical max hit. Keep the spirits between you and the pack, cap elemental resistances, and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 205.1k damage with 32454 effective life and 12478 physical max hit. Refresh the swarm before the burst, keep Flesh Offering up, and recast after every phase change.
